name: graphin
description: graphin — a local codebase-navigation MCP server for AI coding agents, and its adoption instrumentation.

plugins.name: graphin
plugins.description: Local codebase-navigation MCP server with progressive disclosure (search_hybrid → explore_graph → read_code) over Java/Kotlin/Python/JS/TS and RDB schema snapshots. Downloads and verifies its own binary; no checkout required.

plugins.name: graphin-guide
plugins.description: Usage guidance for graphin: a skill teaching progressive-disclosure navigation, and a read-only explorer subagent that returns cited summaries. Separate from the graphin plugin on purpose — installing it is what distinguishes guided use from the no-guidance baseline.

plugins.name: graphin-usage
plugins.description: DEPRECATED — instrumentation moved into the graphin plugin. Install graphin@graphin instead. Updating to 0.2.0 removes this plugin's hook so it stops duplicating events.
